summary: Mynd.ai, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, reporting that NYSE American accepted its plan to regain compliance and granted an extension through December 2, 2027. The company had received a notice on June 2, 2026, for non-compliance due to a stockholders' deficit as of December 31, 2025. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special situation. No deal terms, pricing, or structural changes are disclosed. The company will continue trading while executing strategic initiatives. Watch for milestone compliance and any balance sheet actions.
